title: Mine Island

sourceFacts: The official MineIsland demo shows ten ascending platforms from 1.1x to 100x, an ocean, kangaroo and TNT barrels. A first PLAY attempt was observed to lose and return to PLAY.
unresolved: The marketing page instead describes a rectangular tile/mines game; this conflict is unresolved.
Original-demo continuation controls, provider survival probabilities, rare features, exact artwork and audio remain unverified.
